title: Flowgent demo responses
description: Demo-mode answers of a workflow's agent steps (referenced by workflows[].demo in module.yaml).

steps.description: Responses by step id (the left part of the agent name "<stepId>|<agentId>").

extract.description: Values read from the rendered prompt, used as {name} placeholders in outputs.

field.description: Text after a 'Label:' line of the prompt.

pattern.description: Regex; the first capture group (or the whole match) is the value.

default.description: Used when the value is empty; may contain {prompt}.

rules.description: Ordered rules: the first whose 'when' regex matches the prompt (case-insensitive) wins.

output.description: Output when no rule matches. Strings accept {name} and {prompt} placeholders.
